per_run.unsure_about: A4 fail: mechanism claims 'the diagonal/row overlap' but the actual double-threat structure (verified via 4444332) is entirely on row1 — windows c2r1-c5r1 and c3r1-c6r1 are both horizontal; no diagonal component exists. This is a false geometric claim, not honest abstention.

Phrase 'you handed them the key square in column 2' slightly compresses the causal chain (the played move directly conceded c3r1; c2r1 only became live after the opponent's follow-up move at c3r1) but c2r1 is a genuine required target square and the claim is not board-false, so not scored as an A4 fabrication.
